acceptance.authority: All 41 existing guarded production authorities stay zero; one admitted physical build and candidate partition, no training or best response.
acceptance.candidate: Explicit-board candidate output retains candidate_only=true and physical_provenance=false; measured class dimensions are not assumed.
acceptance.failure: Retain first error, progress counters and partial output; stop without retry, replacement or discarded observations.
acceptance.ranker: Fresh-cache recheck uses the same established independent reference ranker; this is consistency, not a second independent ranking algorithm.
acceptance.source: Identical clean committed HEAD/status and all 44 named dependency LF hashes before/after the single batch.
acceptance.tree: Cycle-free rooted tree, decision-index aliases, public histories, explicit node/depth/stack limits and fresh views/hashes pass.
acceptance.worlds: All 5940 ordered worlds, three exact pair priors, full support, blockers, masses, sign metadata and source counters pass fresh checks.

scope.bounds: Named rank, world, tree, source and output bounds only; not all arithmetic, allocation, elapsed time or RSS.
scope.claims: Reference preparation and candidate partition only. No class/tree equivalence, policy projection/lift, best-response equality, convergence, speed or unrestricted NLHE claim.
scope.provenance: Project-owned standard-library additions; unchanged existing independent physical oracle/ranker/candidate. No third-party source/dependency, shared street kernel, default or Coach change.
